description: Reads one page and checks every JSON-LD node: Product (name, offer price and currency, availability, shipping, returns, brand, identifiers, ratings), Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness, Article, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage and more, against required and recommended fields. Returns a score out of 100, the types found, what is missing per node, parse errors and which types the page should add (for example Product on a product page with none). The generator at /schema-markup-generator writes the fix. One GET request, counts against the free daily limit unless cached.

url.description: The page to check, for example store.com/products/blue-shirt

name: check_schema_markup
title: Check the structured data (schema markup) on a page
